name: Maine
lawPassed: 2021, under An Act To Support and Improve Municipal Recycling Programs and Save Taxpayer Money (LD 1541).
status: Implementation is underway; Maine updated the law in 2025, expects producer registration/data reporting in May 2026 and first annual payments in September 2027 for 2026 packaging.
milestones: Fees tied to volume/type of packaging. SO not yet selected as of mid-2026; RFP issued June 15, 2026.

name: Washington
lawPassed: 2025, under SB 5284 (the Recycling Reform Act, or WRAP Act).
status: Rulemaking, program design and early implementation underway.
milestones: PRO appointed by Jan 1 2026; registration with Ecology by Mar 1 2026; supply report due May 31 2026; producer participation required by July 1 2026.

name: Oregon
lawPassed: 2021, under the Plastic Pollution and Recycling Modernization Act (SB 582).
status: Program rules finalized; producer registration required and fees underway.
milestones: Fees by material/recyclability/volume. Feb 2026: federal injunction for NAW members; trial July 13, 2026. DEQ published ~300 non-compliant producers Apr 9, 2026, fines up to $25k/day.

name: Maryland
lawPassed: 2025, under SB 901 (the Packaging and Paper Products – Producer Responsibility Plans Act).
milestones: CAA registration by July 1 2026; simplified supply report (2025 data) due May 31 2026; covered materials list by July 1 2027; full plans due July 1 2028.

name: California
lawPassed: 2022, under the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act (SB 54).
status: Aggressive timeline with ongoing rulemaking implementation underway.
milestones: 25% source reduction and 65% recycling of plastic by 2032; PRO participation by 2027. Permanent regs finalized May 1 2026. Facing state and federal (17 AGs + NAW) legal challenges; no injunction granted as of writing.

name: Colorado
lawPassed: 2022, under the Producer Responsibility Program for Statewide Recycling Act (HB22-1355).
status: CAA appointed as PRO in 2023; mandatory participation since July 1, 2025; annual dues began January 2026.
milestones: Producers began reporting 2025. Mar 2026: lawsuit challenging a second PRO (LPMA) for petroleum/automotive products - not bagging-relevant.

name: Minnesota
lawPassed: 2024, under the Packaging Waste and Cost Reduction Act (HF 3911/SF 3877).
milestones: Limited registration 2025-2026; PRO operations begin 2027-2028; full requirements (reusable/recyclable/compostable) by 2032.

name: Illinois
lawPassed: Not enacted. HB4064 (Extended Producer Responsibility and Recycling Refund Act) introduced May 21, 2025; remains in proposal stage.
status: Under active consideration as of Jan. 2026; a separate needs-assessment law (PA 103-0383) has findings due Dec. 1, 2026.
milestones: Would require PRO membership with fee modulation favoring recyclable/reusable/PCR content.

name: New Jersey
lawPassed: S3398 (2024-2025 session) died with session end Jan 13, 2026. Reintroduced in 2026-2027 session as S614 and S673 per secondary source; not yet confirmed against official cross-reference.
status: S3398 stalled in Senate Budget & Appropriations and died with the session. Compliance & Risks (secondary source) identifies S614/S673 as reintroductions of the same proposal; not confirmed via an official legislature cross-reference. Official S673 text now on file.
milestones: Would establish EPR program requiring PRO membership or an approved individual plan; 50% source reduction over 10 years proposed in prior version.

name: New York
lawPassed: Not enacted. Packaging Reduction and Recycling Infrastructure Act (SB1464/AB5062, per Sustainable Packaging Coalition tracker).
status: SB1464 shown as introduced Jan. 7, 2026 on the SPC tracker; per Compliance & Risks, still under active consideration as of early 2026.
milestones: No milestones yet; would need Assembly passage to advance.

name: Hawaii
lawPassed: Not enacted. HB750 signed into law July 2025 (per Compliance & Risks; earlier note said May 27 - date not fully reconciled).
status: Requires a statewide needs assessment as a precursor to a potential EPR program.

name: North Carolina
lawPassed: Not enacted. H882 filed 2025; North Carolina named among states considering EPR legislation.
status: Listed as pending/under consideration; no further detail found on committee status in this search pass.

name: Massachusetts
lawPassed: Not enacted. SB571 (also referenced as S.571/H.926).
status: Listed as still under active consideration as of early 2026.

name: Rhode Island
lawPassed: Not enacted. HB6207 enacted June 2025 (needs assessment).
status: BILL NUMBER CORRECTION: prior note referenced 'SB7911' - research finds no such bill; the actual bill is H7911 (House, not Senate). H7910 and S2656 are House/Senate companions creating the same EPR program; both held in committee amid infrastructure/cost concerns.
milestones: No milestones yet; all three bills unreviewed for ACCEPT/REJECT.
